name: DungeonMasonryDamp
height_note: H 0..65535 spans height_range_m; mid level about 0.380

colour_spaces.N: linear, OpenGL (+Y up); flip green on Unreal import
colour_spaces.ORM: linear; R AO, G roughness, B metallic 0
colour_spaces.Macro: linear; R large, G medium, B small low-frequency variation, sample at 1/6 to 1/10 of the tile UV scale

method: the DungeonMasonry wall with the same block layout (so the two blend by mask without ghosting): darker and glossier with vertical run-off streaks, and moss and lichen (from Poly Haven mossy_rock) grown in the joints and on the lower block faces. Meant for the lowest metre of a wall, blended in with the WallGrime R channel or vertex colour
known_weaknesses: moss is a colour and roughness layer with 3 mm of height, not tufts
